subject: Quick walkthrough to review your recent usage uptick
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick walkthrough to review your recent usage uptick

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the spike we saw in your account this week (nice job getting more users through the pipeline!). I noticed BrightPath’s eval project crossed our mid-tier token threshold which unlocks some server-side optimizations that could materially lower per-token cost for you.

If you’ve got 20–30 minutes this week I’d love to do a short walkthrough of:
- what triggered the cost/throughput delta we observed,
- a couple of quick configuration changes (batching, KV-cache hints) that usually shave 15–40% off token spend, and
- a short mutual action plan so we can measure the impact.

Available windows I have: Tuesday 7/13 — 09:00–11:00 or 15:00–17:00 PT, Wednesday 7/14 — 11:00–13:00 PT. If none of those work, send a time that suits and I’ll do my best to accommodate.

I attached a short agenda and will include a calendar invite once we confirm.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
SDR, Redwood Inference
logs: +1 (415) 555-0127
redwood.ai

Attachment: brightpath-walkthrough-agenda.pdf (1 page)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightpath.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough to review your recent usage uptick

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the heads up and for flagging the threshold — really appreciate the proactive reach. We did push a larger batch of requests on Friday which explains the numbers. I’m interested in the cost optimizations but will be out of the office Tuesday afternoon.

Wednesday 7/14 at 11:30 PT would work for me, or Thursday morning if that’s easier on your end. Can you send a calendar invite and short notes on what I should prepare? I’ll loop in our infra lead (cc later if needed).

Best,
Alex Johnson
Product Ops, BrightPath AI
alex.j@brightpath.ai
